$comment: Orazaka workspace manifest — the single list of repositories that make up the platform, in build order. Read by scripts/workspace.mjs, the orazaka CLI and CI.

repositories.name: krizaka-build
repositories.description: Parent POM (Maven Central metadata, Java 21 build conventions, signed release) and BOM of every Krizaka JVM artifact (com.krizaka).

repositories.name: krizaka-platform-kit
repositories.description: Cross-cutting building blocks for Spring Boot services: stateless JWT security with one baseline, service-to-service tokens, idempotent message consumption and a transactional outbox relay.

repositories.name: krizaka-users
repositories.description: Reusable user management for any application: registration, e-mail verification, login (password + Google/GitHub OAuth), forgot/reset password, profile & preferences, API keys, RBAC and JWT issuance — with its contract (krizaka-users-api) and HTTP client (krizaka-users-client).

repositories.name: orazaka-build
repositories.description: Parent POM (Spring Boot / Spring AI BOMs, plugin management, Orazaka BOM) and the shared governance test kit (ArchUnit rules, Testcontainers base) for every Orazaka JVM repository.

repositories.name: orazaka-contracts
repositories.description: Tier-1 platform contracts shared by every Orazaka service: the job plane (jobs-api) and the application-persistence ports (persistence-app-api). Pure interfaces and records, zero implementation.

repositories.name: orazaka-notifications
repositories.description: Channel-based notification delivery for any Krizaka application: e-mail (SMTP), SMS (Twilio) and webhooks behind one DeliveryClient port, driven by platform events (user registered, password reset) or explicit notification requests over AMQP.

repositories.name: orazaka-billing
repositories.description: Credits, wallets, plans, subscriptions, pricebook and metering (hold → settle → release) as a reusable billing service, with its contract (billing-api) and a typed HTTP client (billing-client).

repositories.name: orazaka-studio
repositories.description: Studio & pack marketplace: pack catalogue, studio blueprints, installations and saga-driven runs, with its contract (studio-api) and HTTP client (studio-client).

repositories.name: orazaka-ai-engine
repositories.description: The Orazaka cognitive SDK: AiClient & provider mesh (core), the interceptor pipeline, tools (MCP · RAG · sandbox), use-case orchestration (business), application persistence and asset encryption.

repositories.name: orazaka-conversation-service
repositories.description: Interactive ingress of the Orazaka engine: chat (SSE streaming), intents, models, pipeline, MCP and job APIs — translates transport into Intentions, never business logic.

repositories.name: orazaka-job-service
repositories.description: Asynchronous job executor of the Orazaka engine: drains the interactive and batch lanes, owns the capability registry and the worker registry.

repositories.name: orazaka-knowledge-service
repositories.description: Knowledge & RAG retrieval service (pgvector) with asynchronous indexing.

repositories.name: orazaka-automation-service
repositories.description: Connector automation (Jira, Slack, WhatsApp, Messenger, CLI agents) with Quartz scheduling and execution telemetry.

repositories.name: orazaka-edge
repositories.description: Transparent HTTP edge in front of every Orazaka service: routing, API-key → JWT exchange, CORS and tracing. Spring MVC + virtual threads.

repositories.name: orazaka-worker-media
repositories.description: Native (Metal) Python worker for image/video generation and media composition, speaking the Orazaka AMQP worker protocol.

repositories.name: orazaka-ui-kit
repositories.description: @krizaka/orazaka-shared (TypeScript types, Zod schemas, design tokens) and @krizaka/orazaka-design-system (React components, Tailwind preset, theme, icon registry) for Next.js and React Native apps.

repositories.name: orazaka-web-client
repositories.description: Next.js (App Router) client of the Orazaka platform with its mandatory BFF.

repositories.name: orazaka-web-admin
repositories.description: Next.js SecOps & administration console of the Orazaka platform.

repositories.name: orazaka-mobile-client
repositories.description: Expo / React Native client of the Orazaka platform (talks to the edge with Bearer tokens).

repositories.name: orazaka-cli
repositories.description: The `orazaka` developer CLI: install, start, dev, test, docs and pack tooling for the Orazaka workspace, with an offline SQLite queue.

repositories.name: orazaka-packs
repositories.description: Reference packs for the Orazaka Studio marketplace (document validation, media, prospection, real-estate, wellbeing…) and the pack manifest schema.
